title: GRAP stage band (rules-as-data)
description: Maps an AQI range to a GRAP stage ordinal. THESE ARE LEGAL THRESHOLDS AND LIVE ONLY HERE. They must never appear as literals in application code: a guard test fails the build if an AQI-range integer appears in aadesh_core/domain or aadesh_core/resolver. Until this file is populated from a hashed CAQM order, the IMPLIED stage is UNKNOWN - which is the honest answer, and the one that distinguishes Aadesh from a tool that hardcodes `if aqi > 400`.

pollutant.description: Index or pollutant the band is expressed in, e.g. 'AQI'. Copied from the source, not assumed.

aqi_lower.description: Lower bound copied from the cited source. Inclusivity is explicit when the source uses a strict comparison.

aqi_lower_inclusive.description: False for a strictly greater-than lower bound; true for the closed ranges.

aqi_upper.description: Inclusive upper bound, or null for an open-ended top band.
